SPLIT FILE (output tables). Makes the GLMM output-table images, which

```{r, load packages and working directory}
# FIX (render): every package this file uses is loaded here, at the top.
# Knitting runs the file top to bottom in a fresh R session, so a
# library() call placed after the first use of its functions fails on
# knit even though it works interactively. Two did that here:
#   - glmmTMB: first used in the "glmm version" chunk, but
#     library(glmmTMB) was ~1,300 lines later ("glmmTMB library" chunk)
#   - DHARMa: used from the "glmm version" chunk on, never loaded
# (both only worked if setup.R or an earlier session had loaded them).
# The rest are loaded before first use already; they're listed here too
# so the file doesn't depend on chunk order. lmerTest loads after lme4 so
# every lmer() gets Satterthwaite p-values -- before, the first lmer()
# fit ran between library(lme4) and library(lmerTest) and got none.
# Loading a package twice is harmless, so the later library() calls are
# left in place.
library(tidyverse)   # dplyr, ggplot2, tidyr, stringr, readr
library(scales)      # scales:: label helpers
library(lme4)        # lmer(), glmer()
library(lmerTest)    # Satterthwaite p-values for lmer()
library(glmmTMB)     # Gamma GLMMs
library(DHARMa)      # residual diagnostics
library(car)         # Anova()
library(emmeans)     # emmeans(), emtrends()
library(ggeffects)   # ggpredict()
library(MuMIn)       # r.squaredGLMM()
library(moments)     # skewness(), kurtosis()
library(ggdist)      # stat_halfeye()
library(tidytext)    # reorder_within()
library(ggbeeswarm)  # geom_quasirandom()
library(patchwork)   # combining plots
library(ggforce)     # geom_sina()
```

```{r, load saved models}
rds_dir <- knitr::opts_knit$get("root.dir")
rds_files <- file.path(rds_dir, c("rq1_spatial_models_byrep.rds", "rq1_spatial_models_avg.rds"))
missing_rds <- rds_files[!file.exists(rds_files)]
if (length(missing_rds) > 0) {
  stop("Saved models not found: ", paste(basename(missing_rds), collapse = ", "),
       ". Knit RQ1-spatial_byrep.Rmd and RQ1-spatial_avg.Rmd first.")
}

rq1_spatial_models <- c(readRDS(rds_files[1]), readRDS(rds_files[2]))
rq1_spatial_models <- Filter(Negate(is.null), rq1_spatial_models)

# glmmTMB models read back from disk lose their compiled-code pointer.
# Summary-type output works regardless; if your glmmTMB version has
# up2date(), use it to restore the models fully.
if ("up2date" %in% getNamespaceExports("glmmTMB")) {
  rq1_spatial_models <- lapply(rq1_spatial_models, function(m)
    if (inherits(m, "glmmTMB")) glmmTMB::up2date(m) else m)
}

list2env(rq1_spatial_models, envir = globalenv())
names(rq1_spatial_models)

rq1_img_dir <- "C:/Users/savan/OneDrive - San Francisco State University/ProjectData/GitHub/DepositionSFB/images/rq_1"

# save_glmm_tables() needs both <model> and <model>_avg; this wrapper
# skips (with a message) any model missing a tier.
save_glmm_tables_available <- function(model_list, out_dir) {
  has_both <- vapply(names(model_list), function(m)
    exists(m, envir = globalenv()) && exists(paste0(m, "_avg"), envir = globalenv()),
    logical(1))
  if (any(!has_both)) {
    message("Skipping (not saved in both tiers): ",
            paste(names(model_list)[!has_both], collapse = ", "))
  }
  if (any(has_both)) save_glmm_tables(model_list[has_both], out_dir = out_dir)
}
```

```{r, GLMM output tables}
# One image per GLMM, for both tiers: <model>_byrep.png and <model>_avg.png.
# Each table: fixed effects (log-scale estimate, SE, z, p, exp(estimate)
# with 95% CI), then a footer with Type II Wald chi-square tests, random-
# effect variances, dispersion terms (if any), N, AIC, marginal/conditional
# R2, formula and family. Models come from the .rds files the two tier files save; any model
# missing from either tier is skipped with a message.
#
# Gamma glmmTMB models only. The lmer() SENSITIVITY versions and distmodel
# (a glmer() call with no family, which lme4 silently fits as a Gaussian
# lmer) are not GLMMs in the Rule 2 sense, so they're left out.

rq1_spatial_glmms <- list(
  model_full_glmm                   = "Flux ~ z* x marsh edge type",
  distmodel_glmm                    = "Flux ~ distance from edge",
  distsitemodel_glmm                = "Flux ~ distance x site",
  distsitemodel_glmm_dispersion     = "Flux ~ distance x site, site-specific dispersion",
  distsitemodel_glmm_noGM           = "Flux ~ distance x site, Giant Marsh excluded",
  transite_glmm                     = "Flux ~ transect x site",
  transite1_glmm                    = "Flux ~ transect x site, study phase random effect",
  marsh_edge_model_edge_glmm        = "Flux ~ marsh edge type, (1|Dist)",
  marsh_edge_model_sitetran_glmm    = "Flux ~ marsh edge type, (1|Site/Tran)",
  marsh_edge_model_orient_dist_glmm = "Flux ~ marsh orientation, (1|Dist)",
  marsh_group_model_glmm            = "Flux ~ marsh group (open bay vs. protected)",
  deposition_model_base_glmm        = "Flux ~ z*",
  deposition_model_slope_glmm       = "Flux ~ z* + local slope",
  m_glmm                            = "Flux ~ distance x marsh edge type",
  m_no_giant                        = "Flux ~ distance (factor) x marsh edge type, Giant Marsh excluded",
  m_close                           = "Flux ~ distance x marsh edge type, 0.5 and 2 m only"
)

save_glmm_tables_available(rq1_spatial_glmms, out_dir = rq1_img_dir)
```
